concepts.proposed_markdown:
- Provisioning creates a customer object and an associated contract; at least one contract is required to start metering and rating for billing, while multiple contracts are supported.
- Ingest aliases map internal customer identifiers to the Metronome customer ID, can model sub-organization hierarchies, and may be added retroactively so prior alias-keyed usage is associated with the customer.
- Customer billing-provider configurations are created on the customer and assigned to contracts; multiple configurations allow billing across systems, one per contract.

- A customer can have multiple contracts with distinct rate cards, dates, and discounts; usage filters route events to a selected contract and the guide documents group-key requirements for streaming and SQL billable metrics.
- Custom fields add metadata to contracts or commits for downstream revenue-recognition workflows; the guide gives `salesforce_opportunity_id` as an SFDC mapping example.
